title: Geekvape Digi Q Vista Pod Vape Kit
description: The Geek Vape Digi Q Vista Kit is a visually striking pod vape device that combines performance, versatility, and intuitive features. It’s designed for vapers who want greater control over their vape experience without the complexity of a full mod setup, making it an excellent option for both MTL (mouth-to-lung) and RDL (restricted direct-to-lung) vaping styles, and Nic Salts and 50/50 e-liquids. This refillable pod kit is powered by a robust 1600mAh battery and supports up to 35W of power output. Thanks to its multiple vaping modes—including Smart, Dynamic and Eco—the Digi Q Vista adapts easily to different coils and preferences. Smart Mode adjusts the wattage automatically based on your pod’s coil resistance, while Dynamic and Eco Modes allow for either enhanced vapour or better battery life. The curved, semi-transparent body includes a clear display screen for real-time battery and output monitoring, while inhale or button-activated firing adds further ease of use. The kit is compatible with Geek Vape Q Pods and comes with two coil options: a 0.6ohm pod (pre-installed) for RDL, and a 0.8ohm pod for MTL, both featuring integrated mesh coils and a top-fill system. Please Note: The Q pods that come with this kit are Top fill with a snap off cap. to refill the pod snap off the black cap to expose the fill port. With its sleek, lightweight design, versatile performance, and premium pod compatibility, the Digi Q Vista offers a streamlined vape experience for vapers seeking elegant aesthetics, comfortable ergonomics, power, and flexibility in one kit. Check out our vape juice and pair it perfectly with this kit. We recommend using 50/50 (Freebase) or Nic Salts with this kit. Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Pods, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming' simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
